name: CanSecWest
description: Applied digital-security conference series held in Vancouver, with publicly published presentation and speaker pages.

peerReview.processDescription: Conference presentations are selected through the CanSecWest call-for-papers and organizer review process, then published with named presenters and abstracts.

attribution.attributionNotes: Official CanSecWest pages publish presentation titles, abstracts, speaker names, and links to individual presentation pages.

links.legacySourceNotes: The former cansecwest.com slides index and csw17archive.html URL were researched but currently return 404; historical material is retained as an unresolved source lead rather than a required archive page.

povsAlignment.description: Publicly attributed, technically focused conference presentations and security research.
